scope: Freeze and offline preflight only; no paid experiment started by this commit.

settings.price_convention: peak, cache-miss input price for all tokens; conservative estimate, not invoice
settings.documented_model_version: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; alias backend cannot be independently authenticated

confirmation.when: Only after both reviewers finish all discovery tasks and exactly one eligible candidate is selected; otherwise do not open.
confirmation.comparison: default versus selected profile, each input once; new frozen order and anonymous IDs before requests; no other profile or prompt changes

evaluation.reviewer_context: fork_turns=none; only anonymized input, original source/stdout, factual path/technical validation flags and frozen rubric; no profile/model/timing/cost/expected annotations
evaluation.strong: unchanged rubric threshold; not a consistency veto or release gate
evaluation.joint_creative_ready: both reviewers strong, creativity>=2 and consistency=pass, plus actual model_creative run validation; fallback is not ready
evaluation.contradictions: any reviewer consistency=fail; keep uncertain and disagreement separately, never silently adjudicate
evaluation.ratings: preserve observed scores; missing/unscorable scores remain null
evaluation.primary_creativity_utility: sum observed creativity for scorable generated artifacts over both reviewers / (2 * all planned tasks). Non-creative, failed and unscorable tasks contribute no numerator, without inventing a zero rating. Also publish conditional scorable means and all denominators.
evaluation.primary_set: 12 distinct inputs, repeat=1 only; 2 fixed repetitions are separate stability check

discovery_gate.repeat_joint_ready: at least default across the two fixed repetitions
discovery_gate.mean_all_task_wall_time: at most 2 times default, including failed tasks
discovery_gate.cost_known: all attempted tasks have known usage/accounting; otherwise stop and no selection

evaluation.adoption: Both gates provide a recommendation only. Show gains/cost/latency/failures to maintainer before any production default change. Failure of either gate keeps current defaults; no tuning/regrading/repeated selection on these inputs.

execution_contract: Freeze runner, anonymity mapping, source snapshot and file hashes before first paid request; verify all hashes before every task. Protocol is not an API runner.

Recheck official price/capability pages before payment. If incompatible with frozen prices/model/settings, stop and create a separately versioned protocol before any request; never adjust after observing works.

Use actual public run --play CLI. Clear inherited YESCC_/FCOMP_ model settings, explicitly configure only frozen L3 provider/model/base URL/prices/timeout and isolated config/cache; do not read credentials during offline preflight.

Reserve 0.005 per task append-only before starting, never reclaim phase slots from cheap/failed tasks; max 42 discovery plus conditional 16 confirmation = 0.29 USD, below 0.50 stage ceiling. Host agent cost not included.
No discovery smoke/pilot paid calls beyond listed tasks. Failed task remains in denominator; at most product two candidates/requests per task, no manual reruns or best-of selection.

Record actual request payload and returned model/finish reason/usage/cost-known flags; omit authorization, keys and reasoning text before persistence. Never mutate request or inject reminders after reservation.

Store command, sanitized environment, raw stdout/stderr, report, every received/parsed candidate and actual validation evidence, original input before/after hashes and monotonic wall time; incomplete evidence cannot qualify.
Host process group timeout 195 seconds is a cleanup guard, not the model task wall. Record timeout/cancellation as failure and stop pending children; do not retry manually.

Stop new requests on unknown fees, served-model mismatch across arms, changed source/protocol/price assumptions or unsupported controls. Preserve completed/failed evidence and full task denominators; incomplete batch is not a fair quality result.

Actual token cap may be below requested 4096 and lower on retry; thinking and visible output share it. Disabled profiles send temperature 0.4, low omits it; this is a practical configuration comparison, not an isolated causal effect of reasoning.
Local cache disabled does not disable provider prefix caching. Report provider cache-hit usage separately, still use conservative full input pricing.
No automatic model reviewer, search, database, prompt supplements, default sanitizer, new model routing or expanded budgets. No merge/release/install replacement in this phase.

Before any paid execution, implement and offline-test an HTTP boundary guard that prevents any next request within the same CLI task after unknown fees/model drift/unsupported controls; a post-task report check alone is insufficient. This guard is not yet an API runner in this preparation commit.

For fake-server CLI rehearsal, --provider overrides BASE_URL env using the provider registry: explicitly replace that registry with the loopback URL and reject all non-loopback sends. Real runs must audit the selected official endpoint without exposing credentials.
limits: 12 AI-designed inputs from six themes, two AI reviewers and fixed repeats are exploratory; no human gold, representative population or statistical significance.
Old studies are development evidence only. Existing eight sealed inputs have not been parsed for this protocol and stay closed unless discovery gate qualifies.
No true model quality, speed or spending outcome is established by mock/offline preflight.
